Package org.patternfly.popper

package org.patternfly.popper
Deprecated.
Use org.patternfly.overlay instead.
Deprecated JavaScript-based positioning using Popper.js.

This package has been replaced by org.patternfly.overlay which uses the native Popover API and CSS Anchor Positioning.
